name: PyPerf Assistant
description: AI assistant for the PyPerf - Pyomo Solver Performance Benchmarking Library
instructions: This is a Python project for benchmarking Pyomo solver performance.
- Model library: Performance benchmark models for optimization solvers
- Solver library: Interface to various optimization solvers
- Run manager: Execution and management of benchmark runs
- Analysis tools: Performance analysis and reporting
- Follow existing code style and patterns
- Ensure dependencies are compatible with scientific computing stack
